faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) position at IIM Kozhikode is 06 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Plumber/Draftsmen (Civil) Trade or a Three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering. Desirable qualifications include a Plumbing License and an Electrical Wireman License.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India Rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs 23,100/- per month, which includes Rs 300/- towards a telephone allowance.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) position in this recruitment drive by IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the IIM Kozhikode recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve screening of applications, followed by an interview, and finally document verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Kozhikode located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is located in Kozhikode, Kerala, with the pincode 673570.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the IIM Kozhikode Technical Support Staff (MEP Maintenance) recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Kozhikode or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date of application.
